namespace DistinctDegreeAbstract
open Polynomial
theorem existing {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {l : ℕ} {v : Fin l → R}
    (hd : Function.Injective v) : (Matrix.vandermonde v).det ≠ 0 :=
  Matrix.det_vandermonde_ne_zero_iff.mpr hd
#print axioms existing
#check @IsCoprime.wronskian_eq_zero_iff
end DistinctDegreeAbstract
